import { onAgent } from '../rpc/reads.js'
import { readAhead } from './use-async.js'

// An ended agent's saved log, as the agent's page remembers it between visits.

/** The key the log is remembered under. */
export function agentLogKey(projectId: string, agentId: string): string {
  return `agent-log:${projectId}:${agentId}`
}

/**
 * Read an ended agent's log as the pointer reaches its row, before the click: the page then opens
 * with the chat drawn, where it was blank for the frames the read took.
 */
export function readAgentLogAhead(projectId: string, agentId: string): void {
  readAhead(agentLogKey(projectId, agentId), () => onAgent(projectId, agentId))
}

I fixed the flash and opened PR #2402: https://github.com/openagt/openagent/pull/2402. Switching back to a run you've already opened in this tab now shows its last chat right away. A working run opened for the first time stays blank until its log arrives, and never shows the start line.

**Why it happened:** when you switch, the live feed for the new run starts empty until the daemon has sent the log back again. A working run with an empty log gets its first prompt drawn from its card as the only row. The chat treats a lone prompt in a working run as a session still being set up, so `SessionLine` said "Starting Claude Code 12m 36s".

**The fix:**
- **Chat:** each run's last feed is now remembered, so going back to it shows that chat from the first frame. The full log then replaces it in one step, the same way a reconnect already worked (`lib/use-live-events.ts`). A switch also no longer flashes the previous run's events under the new one for a frame.
- **First visit:** while a working run's log is still on its way, its first prompt is no longer drawn as the only row, and the feed stays blank until the log comes (`components/AgentView.tsx`). A run that really is just starting still shows the "Starting …" line.
- **Branch bar:** "3 files +14 −7" was read from scratch on every switch, so it showed up one read later than the rest of the page. It now shows the run's last count at once and updates when the new read comes back (`packages/ui-pane-changes/dashboard/ChangesSummary.tsx`).

There are three new tests, one per part. I checked that each fails without its fix and passes with it. I didn't watch the recording; I worked from your description of it.

The changed-packages test command in AGENTS.md matched no packages in this worktree, so I ran the tests of `@openagt/ui`, `@openagt/ui-pane-changes` and the packages that depend on them directly. Four tests failed; I don't think any of them comes from this change:
- **Two git tests** expect the test repos' author ("t", "Demo"), but get your git identity from this machine's config.
- **One date test** (`AgentDetails.test.tsx`) expects "Nov 13" but gets the Hebrew date format this machine uses.
- **The Ctrl+K jump e2e test** saw one layout shift during the full parallel run. It passed five times in a row when run on its own. This is the one to keep an eye on, since it switches between runs. The node that moved was the text "p colour", which looks like the session name being typed out letter by letter, not the chat.
